snippet.title: Crimson Loop - Official Steam Release Trailer
snippet.description:
#gamedev #indiedev #indiegame #games #trailer 

Crimson Loop Steam page:https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461810/Crimson_Loop/
Discord:   / https://discord.gg/xemQ7TjceH
Twitch:   / https://www.twitch.tv/notnathanss

Crimson Loop is a 2d, Auto Shooter, Casual, Story game. With heavy inspiration from games like Vampire survivors and Castlevania.  

After spending a bit over a year on what was meant to be a 1 month project, I've finally got this game into a spot that I'm at least semi happy with. Using 99% free assets and a budget of about 300$, Im very happy to say Crimson Loop is finally available to play on Steam for free!

I really wanted to avoid just putting out a game and having it be "Slop" or just having done it for the sake of saying I did. So after working a lot of late nights, and trying to make a playable and at least a little fun game, I feel like I kinda got there in the end :D

Though I'm sure I'm going to have to do quite a bit of patching, and am planning on at least one or two updates, I hope you enjoy Crimson Loop, and am looking forward to the much needed feedback.

 New video soon, and hopefully more to come in the future.

Instagram: / https://www.instagram.com/notnathanss/
Twitter: / https://x.com/NotNathanYT
